summary: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — not real intelligence. A roll-up deal touching two products, a funding round, and a product launch; listicle noise suppressed.

items.headline: PayCo raises $80M Series C to expand embedded payments
items.what_changed: PayCo announced an $80M Series C led by Example Ventures on 22 Oct 2026, earmarked for platform partnerships.
items.why_it_matters: Expect PayCo to outbid Acme Pay on partner revenue share over the next two quarters.
items.follow_up: Ask partnerships for PayCo's current rev-share terms.

items.headline: Rival Books ships AI month-end close assistant
items.what_changed: Rival Books released an AI assistant that drafts reconciliations and close checklists, available on its Cloud tier.
items.why_it_matters: Directly targets Acme Ledger's close-automation differentiator in mid-market deals.

items.headline: Rival Group acquires LedgerLite to bundle with Rival Books
items.what_changed: Rival Group announced it has agreed to acquire LedgerLite; the products will be sold as one suite from Q1 2027.
items.why_it_matters: Gives Rival Books a low-cost entry tier to pitch at Acme Classic customers during the sunset window, and widens the bundle Acme Ledger competes against.
items.follow_up: Brief Acme Classic account managers on retention offers this week.

suggestions.reason: Now part of Rival Group; add as a brand with parent: Rival Group
